name: cerea-vice

scripts.desktop: npm run desktop:setup && npm run build && electron .
scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:setup && npm run build && node desktop/package.mjs
scripts.test:desktop: npm run desktop:setup && npm run build && node --test desktop/smoke.test.mjs
scripts.desktop:package:win: npm run desktop:setup && npm run build && node desktop/package.mjs --platform=win32 --arch=x64

description: A geography-first driving game with loadable real-world neighbourhoods
